title: coronilla glauca var. pentaphylloides
intro: Coronilla glauca var. pentaphylloides, commonly known as Italian clover, is a plant species that belongs to the pea family (Fabaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat gastrointestinal issues and as a diuretic, and is known to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Coronilla glauca var. pentaphylloides include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and coumarins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
